verbose_client.description: Whether to produce some output on the console for the client.

address_client.description: The IP address or hostname the client server is listening on.

port_client.description: The port on which the client server is listening.

datadir_client.description: The directory where the client stores its master secret.

validate_password_client.description: Stores a check digit of 5 bits in the rule blob to notice typos of the master password.

port_server.description: The port on which the server is listening.

ssl_key_server.description: The path to the SSL key file.

ssl_cert_server.description: The path to the SSL certificate file.

datadir_server.description: The root directory where all data is stored.

verbose_server.description: Whether to produce some output on the console for the server.

rl_threshold.description: Increase hardness after rl_threshold attempts if not decaying.

rl_gracetime.description: When checking freshness of puzzle solution, allow this extra gracetime in addition to the hardness max solution time.

pinentry.description: The path of your pinentry program.

log_websphinx.description: A file where websphinx logs, this is only for dev/debug purposes.
